content.comment_body: Hello, Is it possible to connect [product_name] with BACnet IP from [company_name]? Please share your suggestions. Thank you, [user_name]

A direct connection is not feasible. The current [product_name] only supports Ethernet TCP/IP with S7 protocol or Modbus TCP/IP. You will need a gateway to convert BACnet to either of these protocols.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are concerned about integrating [product_name] with [company_name] solutions using BACnet IP. It was clarified that [product_name] does not natively support BACnet IP and only works with TCP/IP protocols like S7 and Modbus, requiring protocol conversion for interoperability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to natively support BACnet IP for direct integration with third-party building automation systems.
